authorship: Original metric geometry and small sculpture silhouettes. Footprints © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0.

primary_evidence.exterior: Travertine giant Corinthian order; five entrance bays below five balconies; four smaller niches; thirteen statues.
Brick double shell with metal armature and travertine, lead-clad cap, sixteen ribs, paired drum columns, lantern, gold globe and cross.
primary_evidence.measurement_basis_quote: External height, from street level to summit of Cross: 133.30 m

primary_evidence.exterior: Four rows; open Tuscan shafts, architrave, roof cornice and balustrade; saints continue along the straight arms.
Travertine/stucco dials in sculptured surrounds at facade corners. Northern Italian clock has one hand.
Plain red granite, no hieroglyphic inscriptions; bronze lions at base and cross on summit.
Travertine and granite, two bowls and lower pool.
Bernini repeats north fountain on opposite side of obelisk.

conflicting_evidence: Vatican RA explicitly states External height, from street level to summit of Cross: 133.30 m. Basilica FAQ rounds to136m without naming a level. Model top is133.30m above selected open-plaza datum; the estimated3.3m threshold rise is not added to this dome dimension. Dome components use plaza datum; nave/facade use threshold datum.
Official Square page describes 16m columns; detailed RA distinguishes 13m shafts and 16.77m colonnade. Geometry follows detailed inventory.
OSM building 54m height applied to whole plan would erase the lower chapels; model roof tiers distinguish 31m side chapel terraces, 49m upper walls and 54m ridge. Those subdivisions are interpreted.

metric_plan.provider: Production Protomaps OSM footprints in east/north metres relative to [41.902166,12.453936].
metric_plan.tile_clipping: 432/1267 share original seed and overlap across tile margin. Half-plane clipping at north=0 removes duplicate portions while retaining the complete basilica outline.
metric_plan.support_uncertainty: All 305 small mapped support positions retained; provider omits true round/rectangular distinction. Near terminal clusters are modeled as square piers, intermediate supports as columns. This subset does not purport to separately count all official 284 columns and 88 piers.

grounding.rejected_ground: Centre and western approach are contaminated by roof elevations; sampled approach climbs 24.5m at x300 to 44.8m at x110 although paving is a gentle incline.
grounding.scope: Conservative lower-only cuts under actual building, ambulacra, colonnade footprints and explicitly authored interior paving. No whole-site rectangular flattening, no roads suppressed beyond authored geometry.

interpretation_limits: Secondary roof tiers, individual statue poses/attributes, facade fine relief and paving bands are original visual interpretations, not exact archaeological copies. No readable substitute inscriptions or invented hieroglyphics. Source Blender preview verifies geometry/color only; actual engine atlas/capture is required for final surface acceptance.
